# `get_planet_position`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Return the current Moon and Sun positions as RA/Dec in degrees, computed by running a packaged script.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (strict grade; 64-bit build; 32-bit build probable). Observer tier B |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0xf5010, LoadUserLocation @0x6dd2c0 (64-bit build); script units from the packaged script text |

No request parameters are read. The device loads the user location (refreshing a memoised copy from configuration when needed, falling back to the mount site), then synchronously runs the packaged planetary calculation script with longitude, latitude and UTC offset hours, and returns the script's Moon and Sun coordinates. The coordinates are degrees, not RA hours.

Side effects: Refreshes a memoised location and timestamp from configuration and runs an external calculation command synchronously with no explicit deadline. Does not persist a location setting or command hardware motion.

| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"get_planet_position"`. [READ] |
| `params` | any | no | - | Not read. Omission, null, object, scalar and array all take the same path. Clients SHOULD omit it. [READ] |

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 214 | The calculation command could not be run | `fail to run command` |
| 207 | The script output did not match the capture pattern, or fewer than five captures were found | `fail to operate` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: method missing or not a string | `invalid request` |

Geographic-location lookup failures are ignored after the fallback. Empty or malformed numeric text from the script is not detected and can produce a malformed reply rather than a typed error.

## Example

Request, request:

```json
{"id":30,"method":"get_planet_position"}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"get_planet_position","result":{"moon":[201.5,-9.2],"sun":[210.8,-13.4]},"code":0,"id":30}
```

Reply, error:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"get_planet_position","error":"fail to run command","code":214,"id":31}
```
